statement: You are given a string expression made only of the bracket characters (, ), [, ], { and }.

The string is balanced when every opening bracket is closed by a bracket of the same type, brackets close in the reverse order they were opened, and no closing bracket appears without a matching opening bracket before it.
Return true if expression is balanced, and false otherwise.

examples.explanation: Each closer matches the most recent unmatched opener, and nothing is left open at the end.
The ) at index 2 arrives while [ is the most recently opened bracket, so the pairs cross instead of nesting.

constraints: expression consists only of the characters ()[]{}
